How do I design a modular adapter system in TypeScript?

Here is how you can design a modular adapter system:

export interface Adapter {
  id: string;
  execute(): Promise;
}

You can then create a central registry to manage them.

Make sure it also supports lifecycle hooks like init() and cleanup().

Here is the updated interface with lifecycle hooks:

export interface Adapter {
  id: string;
  init?(): Promise;
  execute(): Promise;
  cleanup?(): Promise;
}
Now write the Registry class that enforces this.
